description: Explains what an AI employee is at Go-To Local, a Colorado company that builds and runs AI employees for local service businesses: the four employees and where each stands today, the founding pilot price, what the company says it will not do, and that an AI employee tells callers at the start that it is an AI assistant. The text is taken from the Go-To Local website (https://gotolocalai.com/employees) and reflects the site as of its last deploy. No input.
name: what_is_an_ai_employee
title: What is an AI employee?
